title: NCUA share insurance - federal credit unions
facts: Federally insured credit unions are insured through the National Credit Union Share Insurance Fund administered by NCUA.
The standard maximum share insurance amount is $250,000 per individual depositor, per insured credit union, for each account ownership category, subject to applicable rules.
Share insurance covers qualifying deposit/share accounts, not ordinary investment products.
Consumers can verify whether a credit union is federally insured and use NCUA tools to estimate coverage.
